item.title: Operation Paper Lantern: rundll32 and scheduled task persistence
item.dc:creator: Research Team
item.content:encoded:
The operators executed rundll32.exe javascript:"\..\mshtml,RunHTMLApplication" to launch a script loader.

Persistence was created with schtasks /create /tn Updater /tr C:\Users\Public\u.exe /sc onlogon.

A Run key value was written: HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run\Updater pointing to the same binary.

The loader beaconed to update-check.example.net over HTTPS every 300 seconds, using a fixed user agent string. Analysts observed the parent process chain winword.exe, then cmd.exe, then rundll32.exe on three hosts.
